Is Watching Videos at 2x Speed a Bad Idea?

In You Can See Everything , the documentary about Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes and her husband Billy Evans, Evans is often seen busily watching videos on 2x speed . He’s not the only one; many people, especially younger ones , are playing video and audio content at faster speeds to get through the material more quickly.
